description: Multi-turn support conversations. Each session is one ordered conversation; turns within a session share one session_id so short-term memory accumulates. Across the corpus the turns exercise all three agents (orchestrator routing + knowledge agent for policy/FAQ + order agent for order/shipping/subscription/refund). `user_id` is a synthetic benchmark identity (not a real Cognito user); the sliders max at 5 sessions x 5 turns, so the authored corpus is exactly 5 x 5.

turns.message: What is your return policy?

Is international shipping available to Canada?

Can I pause it for a couple of months instead of cancelling?
